slides.title: Chicco: your coffee bean is a seed
slides.subtitle: It starts as a fruit. Follow its journey to your cup.

slides.title: Chicco means coffee bean
slides.body: Chicco is the Italian word for a coffee bean. Botanically, though, it's a seed: the one inside the fruit of the coffee tree, called the cherry.

slides.title: From cherry to cup
steps: The coffee tree grows fruit: the cherry.
The seed is freed from the fruit and dried.
Hulling removes the last dry layers.
Roasting makes it brown and aromatic.

slides.title: Two ways to free the seed
A seed that could be a tree
slides.body: If a coffee seed isn't processed, it can be planted and grow into a coffee tree. Drying, hulling and roasting turn it into the chicco you brew.
slides.highlight: Roasting is the last step before brewing.

slides.title: Every chicco is a seed
slides.body: Fruit, seed, roast: that's how a cherry becomes your coffee.
